text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! You have improved,
Tempest Lord.
However...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It was not enough to halt the newly
awakened
Centurial Overlord's surge
through frozen tundra!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... You're too strong, Opera O...

T.M. Opera O has defeated Meisho
Doto.

It appears as though their conflict has
been
settled for now...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What say you, Doto? With this act
concluded, is
it not time to define our
roles betwixt each other?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Answer me, Meisho Doto! Who are you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Are you my lifelong adversary? Do you
play a
part in Ragnarok, the seemingly
endless battle of
the gods?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngghhh... Um... Uh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Will I become your adversary?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I will... NOT!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wha... How can this be?!

Poignant words echo through the crisp
fall air in
Fuchu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
After running with you today... now I
know for
sure that you're not my enemy,
Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're my idol, the one I'll keep running
after—as
long as I liiiive!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I only got as strong as I am now because
of you...
And I can get even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're not my enemy, you're...
something more
comforting. There's no
reason for me to want to
hurt you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So I want to be your... rival! Not your
adversary,
but your lifelong rival.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the rival who runs with you

always—sometimes winning, sometimes
losing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I think... I'll be happiest that way.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Happiest, you say...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Doto... I see you have found
your
answer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then so it shall be!

T.M. Opera O pulls Meisho Doto to the
front of
the stands.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me! All fans in attendance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From this day forth, Meisho Doto will be
my
closest rival!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I wish for you to watch our beautiful
bond as we
come to understand one
another through our
fierce battles on the
track.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And I hereby promise this! With a worthy

adversary at my side, I will continue to
build my
shining momentum...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And overcome the Golden Generation at
the
end-of-the-year Arima Kinen!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Will that suffice, my dear friend Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um, also... Please do your best at
the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So I shall. I'll do my part as ruler of our
generation
to represent you and Ayabe
as well.

And so their tale comes to a happy
conclusion,
with the two hand in hand as
friends and
competitors.

But the real battle starts now. The
mightiest
generation awaits the
mightiest king at the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us be off, Trainer, to the last grand
spectacle.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With Doto unable to join, it seems I
alone will
enter the fray against the
heroes of the previous
generation...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But fear not! With you at my side, we
can
overcome anything!

We exchange looks as we reaffirm our
fervent
determination. T.M. Opera O
then turns to the
sold-out stands.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen! I am T.M. Opera
O! And
today, my generation has been
unified.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We shall hereby be known as the T.M.
Opera
Opposition!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As you are well aware, Umamusume are
entered
into the Arima Kinen based on
popular vote.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Which means your support is vital if I am
to make
it to the top. So hear me now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I beseech you, everyone gathered at this
track, to
vote for the T.M. Opera
Opposition! Together,
we cannot be
defeated!

She implores the crowd for their votes.
Perhaps
lost in the moment, she begins
sounding like a
politician.
